{{Quote|A former commander in the Republic Regions security force, Tarkin was most recently the lieutenant governor of Eriadu. He now oversees the greater Seswenna sector with a special emphasis on emerging military technology.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
The '''Greater Seswenna''' was originally a region of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], consisting of [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. The Greater Seswenna has appeared by [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]]. It was the area patrolled by [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]], that consisted of associated [[Planetary Security Forces]] of Seswenna and surrounding sectors.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The Greater Seswenna was later expanded to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], also known by this time as '''Sector 18''', as he became the theaters of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Eighteenth Army|18th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]]. [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Greater Seswenna, received a rank of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>

Under Imperial rule, the Greater Seswenna was later reorganized as [[Oversector Outer]] as part of the Imperial militarization suggested by Grand Moff Tarkin.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
